title: Fix reserved-lot re-picking after warehouse reclassification
summary: Reserved lot re-picking is now possible after warehouse reclassification by correcting the calculation of reserved quantity on inventory to account for registered shipment quantities before adding outstanding pick calculations.
key_points: Fixed issue where reserved lots could not be re-picked after warehouse reclassification and shipment deletion
Modified Warehouse Availability Mgt.CalcLineReservedQtyOnInvt to apply shipment-bin guard to registered quantities
Guard remains item-wide to prevent duplicate global credit calculations
Added seven comprehensive tests covering re-pick/lot-validation/registration flows and protective controls
No breaking changes to public interfaces or existing helper functions
